transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, November 14. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Nvidia probe, China spy claims: Trump unlikely to confront Xi over Alice Huang. Next week, US President Donald Trump will engage with Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC summit, despite claims regarding businesswoman Alice Huang and her connection to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang surfacing in the media. Sources reveal that Trump won't cover these allegations during his talks with Xi. Nvidia is conducting a separate inquiry into Alice Huang's supposed espionage, which Beijing firmly denies amid the ongoing investigation. Class 12 boy dies by suicide during video call with girlfriend; girl also kills herself. A devastating incident unfolded as 18-year-old students Jeet Biswas and Puja Mondal took their lives while connected via video call. Following a chilling conversation, Jeet hanged himself, prompting Puja to do the same in despair. Their families were oblivious to their relationship, despite whispers of parental discontent in the neighborhood. Bengaluru woman turns rupees 5,000 cupcakes into rupees 1 crore bakery. Megna Jain began her entrepreneurial adventure at the tender age of 18, introducing her cupcake business during college in Bengaluru. With a startup investment of rupees 5,000, she navigated early struggles and eventually created Dream A Dozen. The pandemic inspired a creative shift towards corporate gifting, propelling her sales and expanding her client base to over 500. Just 6th overall and 1st in Pak's history: Saud joins rare Test batting record list. Shakeel, who had scored 93 in Pakistan's first innings total of 434/9 declared, fell just three runs short of his century in the second innings. The left-hander spent most of the fifth and final day at the crease before Lahiru Kumara bowled him after he had faced 210 deliveries. US flight disruptions: Air India warns of possible operational delays. Travelers on Air India flights faced significant delays due to a nationwide communication failure that affected the FAA, leading to a temporary ground halt of all flight departures across the U.S. Although the ground stop has since been lifted, passengers should brace for ongoing disruptions as the situation unfolds. Investigations are in progress to pinpoint the cause behind this communication breakdown, with safety being the top priority for FAA officials. US flight disruptions: Nationwide ground stop ordered for only the second time since 9/11. The United States witnessed its second nationwide aviation disruption of this kind since the September 11, 2001, terror attacks after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) halted departures across the country for more than four hours on Friday due to communications failures affecting multiple air traffic control centres. Farmer turns 1,200 acres into wildlife haven, rare species return. A decade-long restoration project in west Norfolk has brilliantly converted agricultural land into a vibrant natural habitat. Spearheaded by Olly Birkbeck in collaboration with Natural England, this initiative has attracted a wealth of wildlife. By replanting local flora with meticulously sourced native seeds and employing conservation grazing techniques, the project effectively manages habitats, keeping invasive species at bay while promoting overall biodiversity and encouraging ecological connectivity in the region. Father calls co-pilot daughter killed in Florida crash a 'hero'. The father of 20-year-old co-pilot Nathalia Filgueiras, who was killed along with eight others in a Learjet crash on a Florida highway, has spoken about the pain of hearing the aircraft's final radio transmissions. Calling his daughter a hero, Allan Filgueiras is seeking answers about the crash, questioning why the aircraft continued through bad weather instead of diverting. US flight chaos: What caused FAA outage that grounded departures nationwide. A telecommunications outage affecting regional air traffic control centres disrupted air travel across the United States on Friday, prompting the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to order a nationwide halt to flight departures. Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan add historic Irish castle to portfolio. Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have acquired Strancally Castle in County Waterford for €51.17 million. The historic estate spans 440 acres and includes a Gothic mansion overlooking the River Blackwater. Its prior owners expressed happiness about the sale and hope for its maintenance. The castle will serve as a family residence during business trips to Ireland. Texas couple finds strangers building on their lot; notary claims dismissed. A couple in Texas discovered their property had been allegedly sold by an impersonator. After construction began on the land, they informed the parties involved of the dispute. The notary claimed he was not responsible as the notarization occurred in Colorado. The Texas Fourth Court of Appeals ruled there was no personal jurisdiction over the notary. Matt Henry's three-ball demolition exposes India's batting frailties ahead of WC. Matt Finishes India Off With Devastating 6/27, Including Wickets Of Rohit, Kohli and Iyer In Opening Over, As India Sink To Second-Biggest Defeat In ODIs; Will Young Sizzles With Ton In 244
